title: Ketone Body Metabolism in Cancer-Associated Fibroblasts andas Prognostic and Therapeutic Determinants of Chemoradiotherapy Response in Cervical Cancer.
snippet: Concurrent chemoradiotherapy (CCRT) is a cornerstone of treatment for locally advanced cervical cancer, although many patients show a poor response. The tumor microenvironment (TME) is a key determinant of therapeutic resistance and prognosis, with the metabolic reprogramming within specific cellular subsets playing a particularly important role.
